description: Issue #839 AC4, the Turtle & Rendering half of "nothing shadows": `define forward :n … print 999 … end` then `forward 10`. Phase-1 registration raises `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/error-model.md:125`), matching what `check()` reports. The empty event stream is the assertion that matters: a `print` payload of `999` would mean the shadow is back, and a `move` payload would mean the primitive silently won instead.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
